notes.title: 12.19 Update log
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added an optional initial character - Fuxi
[*] Added cards and treasures related to Fuxi characters
[*] Adjusted the passive abilities of the characters Shen Nong and N ü wa, and now their initial abilities have been improved.
[*] Optimized the mechanism of some bosses and reduced the overall difficulty of the game
[*] Fixed a large number of game bugs
[/list]


Sorry players, the game hasn't been updated for a long time.The new character Fuxi was actually completed in October, but there were too many bugs. The project team tested it continuously for a long time, and finally there are no fatal issues with the version now (of course, there are still some small problems that haven't been completely identified. Players are welcome to provide them to the project team). Although the progress is slow and arduous, the project team will not give up halfway and will definitely persist in completing the game. Finally, we would like to thank all the players for their feedback and assistance. We plan to launch a new challenge mode in January 2024 (which we have already done halfway through), and release the fourth ranked character and related content in the first half of 2024. Stay tuned.

notes.title: 7.26 Update Log
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Game Experience Optimization[/b][/h3]
Remake the exclusive treasure of the Nuwa character
Green lotus has been modified to upgrade all mist cards to rainbow cards
Qingluan has been modified to Deals 8 damage per card discarded
Pearl hairpin has been modified to For each card played, deal 2 damage and receive 2 armor points 
Added damage caused by Filling attack card
Added armor obtained by Filling defense card
Strengthened the effect of upgrading the based free card
Removed self harm mechanism for refresh cards
Added achievement system

[h3][b]Game bug fix[/b][/h3]
Fixed issue where some card names cannot be displayed
Fixed an issue with abnormal discard during battles

After overtime testing by the project team, it was found that the character of Nuwa is still too weak in difficult challenges. Therefore, the project team decisively abandoned some useless designs and strengthened Nvwa's hoping to give everyone a better gaming experience. In addition, the number of game bugs has significantly decreased this week, and we continue to welcome everyone to join groups and leave comments to provide us with various opinions

notes.title: Version 1.0 of "Nine Territories Legends—the Sun Disaster" was launched
notes.notes:
After a period of testing and frantic bug fixing by the project team, "Nine Territories Legends—the Sun Disaster" has finally been officially launched today.
The current game content includes
1. 2 available characters: Shennong and Nuwa
2. 5 game chapters
3. almost all props and cards
4. 10 challenge difficulties
Although currently lots of bugs has been fixed by the project team, there are still existing some bugs that have not been fixed or discovered. Players who care about this can wait for a more stable version before purchasing. Purchased players can provide us with bugs they’ve discovered in the comment section or QQ community; and they will receive gratitude and rewards from the project team. At last, the project team's Bilibili account: Mufan Game Gua Association will soon start a game activity for activation code drawing. Welcome to follow and participate.
